items.situation: student seeking help at the writing center
items.speaker: How do I get feedback if I'm stuck?

options.A: Actually, there's a walk-in slot at three.
options.B: The feedback form is online now.
options.C: I turned in the lab report already.
options.D: In the tutoring room by the stairs.

items.explanation: 对方问「卡住了怎么拿到反馈」，A 用话语标记 Actually 开头，直接给出可行路径——三点有免预约名额，是最自然的推进（marker_led_indirect）。B 抓住 feedback 这个词转去讲「反馈表在线上」，只是词汇联想，没有回应「怎么拿到帮助」。C 说自己交了实验报告，完全另起话题。D 「在楼梯旁的辅导室」回答的是「在哪里」，问的却是「怎么办」，属于答非所问。

items.situation: student checking lost-and-found at the front desk
items.speaker: What's the process for claiming a lost jacket?

options.A: That jacket looks warm enough for winter.
options.B: Well, just describe it and sign the log.
options.C: I need to mail a package today.
options.D: Usually about two weeks in the bin.

items.explanation: 问的是认领流程，B 以 Well 起头再给出两步做法（描述外套、登记签字），正好回应流程（marker_led_indirect）。A 借 jacket 这个词去评论外套暖不暖，是词汇联想陷阱。C 说自己要寄包裹，与问题毫无关系。D 「一般在箱子里放两周」回答的是「保存多久」，不是「怎么认领」，问题类型错配。

items.situation: student asking a librarian whether an atlas can be checked out
items.speaker: Doesn't this atlas circulate to students?

options.A: The air circulates better near the windows.
options.B: I loved the maps in that atlas.
options.C: Off the top of my head, yes.
options.D: My study group meets on the fourth floor.

items.explanation: 学生问这本地图册是否可以外借，C 用固定说法 off the top of my head（凭印象、没细查）给出肯定回答，既自然又留有余地（idiomatic）。A 把 circulate 当成「空气流通」的另一个义项，是一词多义陷阱。B 借 atlas 去抒发「我很喜欢里面的地图」，只谈感受不回答能不能借。D 说自己的学习小组在四楼碰面，完全离题。

items.situation: student trying to get tickets for a campus concert
items.speaker: I've been trying to get tickets for the spring concert.

options.A: That band's last album was really good.
options.B: I dropped my keys somewhere near the gym.
options.C: Yes, I'd love to come with you.
options.D: Well, the box office opens again tomorrow.

items.explanation: 对方在说自己一直抢不到票，D 以 Well 起头给出有用的下一步——售票处明天再开，正是这句话最想要的回应（marker_led_indirect）。A 顺着 concert 去夸乐队专辑，是词汇联想陷阱。B 说自己在健身房附近丢了钥匙，完全离题。C 把「我在抢票」误当成「邀请你一起去」，理解错了说话人的意图。

items.situation: two friends deciding where to get lunch
items.speaker: Don't you have class right after lunch?

options.A: Actually, I've only got twenty minutes.
options.B: That class meets in the science building.
options.C: My laundry should be done by now.
options.D: In the courtyard behind the union.

items.explanation: 朋友提醒「你午饭后不是有课吗」，A 以 Actually 起头，用「我只有二十分钟」间接确认并把话题推向「那就吃快的」（marker_led_indirect）。B 抓住 class 去说这门课在理科楼上，只借词不回应。C 说自己的衣服该洗好了，完全离题。D 「在学生中心后面的院子里」回答的是「在哪儿」，而对方问的是有没有课，问题类型错配。

items.situation: student who has just missed the last shuttle
items.speaker: I've just missed the last shuttle again.

options.A: The shuttle holds about thirty people.
options.B: Can't you catch the city bus instead?
options.C: I finished that assignment on Sunday night.

items.explanation: 对方在诉苦「又没赶上末班车」，B 反问「那你能不能改坐市区公交」，用一个问句把对话推向解决办法，是最自然的接话（counter_question）。A 借 shuttle 去讲车能坐多少人，是词汇联想陷阱。C 说自己周日晚上写完了作业，完全离题。D 「每二十分钟一班，开到九点」回答的是发车频率，对方并没有问班次，问题类型错配。

items.situation: coordinating an airport pickup with a friend
items.speaker: Why can't you get to the airport by five?

options.A: The airport parking garage was rebuilt.
options.B: She left her sweater in my car.
options.C: Well, the traffic gets bad after four.
options.D: Around six, if the flight's on time.

items.explanation: 问的是「为什么五点前到不了机场」，C 以 Well 起头给出原因——四点以后就开始堵车，间接但完整地回答了 why（marker_led_indirect）。A 借 airport 去讲停车楼翻新，是词汇联想陷阱。B 说她把毛衣落在车里，完全离题。D 「大概六点，如果航班准点」回答的是「几点到」，问的却是原因，问题类型错配。

items.situation: friend worrying aloud about finding somewhere to live
items.speaker: Where do I look if I can't afford the dorms?

options.A: The dorms filled up back in April.
options.B: The library extended its hours this month.
options.C: Sometime before the lease deadline, probably.
options.D: My cousin's subletting hers — I'll ask.

items.explanation: 朋友其实是在为「住哪儿」发愁，D 不去列举该上哪些网站找房，而是直接给出一条真实门路——表姐正在转租，我帮你问，绕开字面问题解决了根本需求（context_shift）。A 借 dorms 去说宿舍四月就满了，只重复困境不帮忙。B 讲图书馆延长开放时间，完全离题。C 「大概在租约截止前吧」回答的是「什么时候」，问的却是「去哪儿找」，问题类型错配。

items.situation: student stuck on the last item of a problem set
items.speaker: What if I can't finish problem four tonight?

options.A: That problem set was assigned last Tuesday.
options.B: Come by later — I've got it worked out.
options.C: The cafeteria stopped serving breakfast at ten.
options.D: Yes, it was on the syllabus.

items.explanation: 对方担心今晚做不完第四题，B 不去讨论「做不完会怎样」，而是直接解决问题——过来找我，我已经把这题做出来了（context_shift）。A 借 problem set 去说这套题上周二就布置了，只借词不帮忙。C 说食堂十点停供早餐，完全离题。D 「是的，大纲上写了」用是否作答，而对方问的是万一做不完该怎么办，问题类型错配。

items.situation: roommate complaining about a delayed package
items.speaker: I've been waiting on that package all week.

options.A: That package looked pretty heavy earlier.
options.B: I signed up for the pottery class.
options.C: Tell me about it — mine's still stuck.
options.D: No, I haven't ordered anything lately.

items.explanation: 室友在抱怨包裹等了一周，C 用固定说法 Tell me about it（可不是嘛）表示感同身受，再补一句自己的也还没到，是口语里最自然的接话（idiomatic）。A 借 package 去说「那个包裹看着挺沉」，只借词不接情绪。B 说自己报了陶艺课，完全离题。D 「没有，我最近没网购」把对方的抱怨误当成在问自己有没有下单，理解错了意图。
